description: Tap the screen. Coordinates from snapshot_ui are exact device pixels — prefer them over estimating positions by looking at a screenshot image. Instead of pixels you can pass screen percentages (0-1): safer when estimating positions from a screenshot image.

serial.description: Device serial (defaults to session or the only device)

xPct.description: X as fraction of screen width (0-1)

yPct.description: Y as fraction of screen height (0-1)
